title: Periodic warped universal covers of closed oriented and time-oriented Lorentz three-manifolds with noncompact isometries and a nonhomogeneous hyperbolic integrability component
author: Charles Frances
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.37
difficulty_reason: The author extracts a compact Anosov Lorentz torus from generalized-curvature recurrence, proves nondegeneration and completeness of its normal flow using hyperbolic dynamics and a Lorentz isometric-extension theorem, then identifies the return quotient and warped universal cover. This global Lorentz-dynamical construction exceeds ordinary qualifying examinations.
